description: A software update framework for macOS

latest_release.name: 2.10.1 Golden Gate Bump
latest_release.body:
Changes:

* Fix not trimming whitespace/newline characters from <sparkle:releaseNotesLink> (#2944) (Zorg)
* Fix update being installed prematurely if it's located in NFC unicode encoded path (#2943) (Zorg)
* Update Danish translation (#2940) (Sebastian Livoni)
* Add missing "Install on Quit" localizations for uk, ru, fr, es, pt-PT. (#2931) (Andrii Selivanov)
* Add and update translations for Chinese (Hong Kong) (zh-HK) (#2926) (Tiffany Fung)
* Drop stale sparkle:format when generate_appcast embeds HTML release notes (#2927) (Leo Camus)
* Skip en and Base when recording Sparkle locales in generate_appcast (#2925) (Leo Camus)
* Fix appcast child elements being ignored when the Sparkle namespace uses a custom prefix (#2923) (Leo Camus)

macOS 12.0 or later is required (due to Xcode 27 dropping support for deploying to older OS versions). CocoaPods support is also now dropped.

If you're not generating appcasts automatically, remember to add `<sparkle:minimumSystemVersion>12.0</sparkle:minimumSystemVersion>` element to `<item>`s in your appcast.

[Discussion](https://github.com/sparkle-project/Sparkle/discussions/2913)

Please also check [2.10.0](https://github.com/sparkle-project/Sparkle/releases/tag/2.10.0) for previous changes.
